name: homework-helper-skill
description: Helps children and students with homework and school subjects, searching the web when needed and explaining answers simply and safely for ages 6 to 15.

intents.description: Help with schoolwork, homework, or studying — explaining a concept, answering a subject question (science, history, geography, English, etc.), or helping understand a topic. Use for learning questions, especially from children and students.
example_utterances: Explain the water cycle for my science homework
What caused the First World War?
I don't understand my history homework about the Mughals
